mainText: Flex your football brain with our daily quizzes. Test your football knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser. Man Utd & Arsenal eye Croatia striker - Sunday's gossip. Three Premier League clubs are interested in Freiburg striker Igor Matanovic, Juventus want Liverpool centre-back Giovanni Leoni, Newcastle willing to let Joe Willock leave in January, plus more. Ronaldo still 'greatest symbol' of Portugal -  Fernandes. Portugal midfielder Bruno Fernandes says Cristiano Ronaldo remains the country's greatest footballing figure despite leaving the squad this week after finding out he would not start a match.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Courts backlog will still fall despite scrapping of jury trial plan, minister says. Proposals to limit jury trials were first introduced by former justice secretary David Lammy last year. Badenoch unveils plan to end £100,000 childcare 'cliff edge' ahead of Tory conference. The Conservative leader tells the BBC the earnings threshold for government support stops people "working harder". Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country. State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel. Glastonbury 2027 tickets sell out in 42 minutes. Thousands of people joined the queue in the hope of securing tickets to Worthy Farm.
